items: : **U19 Cricket World Cup** — India won 6th title (Feb); Vaibhav Suryavanshi, Player of Match & Series. **WPL 2026** — RCB won 4th title. **Winter Olympics 2026** (Milan-Cortina) — Norway topped medal table. **Vijay Hazare Trophy** — Vidarbha won maiden title (Jan). **6th Khelo India Winter Games** (Ladakh) / **2nd Khelo India Beach Games** (Dadra & Nagar Haveli) (Jan) — same brand, different editions/locations.
Final **8 March 2026** (International Women's Day), Narendra Modi Stadium, Ahmedabad; 10th edition.
India beat New Zealand by 96 runs; Captain Suryakumar Yadav; Player of the Match Jasprit Bumrah; Player of the Tournament Sanju Samson.
Milestones: **1st team to win back-to-back T20 WC titles**; **1st team to win on home soil**.
Previous India wins: 2007 (Dhoni, hosted South Africa), 2024 (Rohit Sharma, hosted West Indies/USA).
